title: Vincent van Gogh, Skull of a skeleton with burning cigarette, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Continuation of the prestigious Dark Edition series Dark symbol of reflection on transience and the fragility of life Van Gogh’s iconic painting in a unique collectible form Vincent van Gogh, a master of emotion and symbolic expression, used this painting to present a provocative take on the irony of life and death. The artwork balances on the fine line between dark humor and profound reflection on the fragility of human existence. This silver coin featuring the famous motif becomes not only a rare collector’s piece but also a symbol of distance from life’s final matters and a tribute to art that dares to make us think. Just as we take a walk in the sunshine, we must also learn to walk in the dark. Vincent van Gogh
